2607.15776.title: NeurOWL: An LLM-Based Neural-symbolic Framework for Incomplete OWL Ontology Reasoning
2607.15776.paper_summary: OWL ontologies provide a formal knowledge representation framework that enables semantic reasoning, and have been widely adopted across domains such as healthcare and bioinformatics. In practice, however, real-world ontologies are often incomplete, which pose challenges for reasoning. In this work, we focus on a fundamental subsumption reasoning problem: given an incomplete ontology and a candidate (non-entailed) subsumption, determine whether the subsumption is semantically plausible and, if so, providing a logically sound explanation containing potential missing axioms. This task unifies subsumption verification with ontology abduction, and generalizes the latter by removing the need for a predefined candidate set of missing axioms. To address this subsumption reasoning problem, we propose NeurOWL, an end-to-end neuro-symbolic framework that jointly performs verification and abduction, leveraging both formally defined semantics and textual semantics through Large Language Models and ontology embeddings. We evaluate NeurOWL on real-world ontologies across multiple domains, demonstrating strong and robust performance across different domains.
2607.15776.paper_summary_zh: OWL 本體提供了一個正式的知識表示框架，能夠實現語義推理，並已被廣泛應用於醫療保健和生物資訊等領域。<lb/>然而，在實踐中，現實世界的本體往往是不完整的，這對推理造成了挑戰。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們專注於一個基本的包含推理問題：給定一個不完整的本體和一個候選（非推導）包含，確定該包含是否在語義上是合理的，如果是，則提供一個邏輯上合理的解釋，包含潛在缺失的公理。<lb/>這項任務將包含驗證與本體推斷統一起來，並通過消除對預定義缺失公理候選集的需求來概括後者。<lb/>為了解決這個包含推理問題，我們提出了 NeurOWL，一個端到端的神經符號框架，該框架共同執行驗證和推斷，利用正式定義的語義和通過大型語言模型及本體嵌入的文本語義。<lb/>我們在多個領域的現實世界本體上評估了 NeurOWL，展示了其在不同領域的強大和穩健的性能。
